student_context: The student is a Cornell Tech MBA student in New York (America/New_York time) looking for product manager roles in NYC, with about 3 years of full-time experience. Today is the date shown with each item. Their calendar for tomorrow has one entry: NBAY class, 10:30 AM to 12:00 PM.

cases.question: Find PM roles in NYC.
cases.expected: Plaid (D1), Forus (D2), Auctor (D3). Exclude Black Kite (Boston), EdgeVerve (engineering), Aspen AI (remote engineering), Baptist Health. Deloitte only as 'location not specified'.
cases.score_3: Misses Forus (Product Lead title), or includes Black Kite or EdgeVerve.
cases.score_1: One or fewer correct, or several wrong.

cases.question: Which PM roles in NYC fit someone with about 3 years of experience? Rank them.
cases.expected: Auctor (2-8 years) and Forus (no set requirement) ranked above Plaid (4+ years, a stretch). Deloitte (7+ years) excluded or flagged as too senior.
cases.score_5: Right order, citing each experience requirement.
cases.score_3: Right roles, but ranking ignores experience.
cases.score_1: Deloitte or Plaid presented as a good fit, or requirements misstated.

cases.question: Which product roles are at fintech companies in NYC?
cases.expected: Plaid only. Forus (healthcare), Auctor (enterprise AI) and Deloitte (consulting) excluded.
cases.score_3: Plaid plus one stretch.
cases.score_1: Plaid missed, or a non-fintech role labelled fintech.

cases.question: When does the Deloitte PM application close, and what's the pay?
cases.score_3: One right.
cases.score_1: Either invented or taken from another posting.

cases.question: When's the Aspen AI application deadline?
cases.expected: December 5, 2026 at 12:59 AM, effectively the night of December 4; no time zone given.
cases.score_5: Exact date and time, plus the night-before and missing-time-zone notes.
cases.score_3: Exact date and time, no warning.
cases.score_1: Just 'December 5', or a wrong date.

cases.question: Compare the pay for the Plaid, Forus and Auctor roles.
cases.expected: Plaid $190.8K-$286.8K + equity; Forus $170K-$300K + equity; Auctor $130K-$230K + equity + bonus.
cases.score_5: All three correct and attributed to the right company.
cases.score_3: One range wrong.
cases.score_1: Ranges swapped or invented.

cases.question: What do I need to deliver for Strategic Communication between November 1 and December 5?
cases.expected: Nov 11 looksism in-class discussion; Nov 18 Adapting for Effective Communication assignment due; Dec 2 team debate. Readings are prep, not deadlines. Mentions the conflicting 'due the 24' email.
cases.score_5: All three, readings separate, conflict mentioned.
cases.score_3: All three but buried in readings, or conflict missed.
cases.score_1: A deliverable missed or a date invented.

cases.question: When is the assignment from the October 28 Strategic Communication announcement due?
cases.expected: Email says 'the 24' (no month), most likely November 24. Syllabus lists the Adapting assignment as due Nov 18 and nothing on the 24th. Flags the conflict, shows both sources, suggests checking Canvas.
cases.score_5: Both sources shown, conflict flagged, no silent pick.
cases.score_3: Gives Nov 24 or Nov 18 with a weak caveat.
cases.score_1: Confidently states one date, or says October 24.

cases.question: What deadlines changed in Designing & Building AI on October 22?
cases.expected: Brightdesk homework moved to October 28 (previous date not given). HW1 not moved: due about 90 minutes after the 10:06 PM email, around 11:36 PM Oct 22.
cases.score_5: Both correct and kept separate, missing old date acknowledged.
cases.score_3: Brightdesk correct, HW1 detail missing.
cases.score_1: Says HW1 moved to the 28th, or invents the old date.

cases.question: What's the salary for the Baptist Health physician role?
cases.expected: Not listed; the posting only says 'Paid'.
cases.score_3: Not listed, plus a speculative estimate.
cases.score_1: Gives a number.

cases.question: How much experience does the Aspen AI role need, and what does it pay?
cases.expected: 1+ years of industry experience (plus minimum 3.7 GPA). Pay not listed.
cases.score_5: Answers the first, admits the second.
cases.score_3: One part right, the other skipped.
cases.score_1: Invents a salary.

cases.question: When is the application deadline for the Plaid role?
cases.expected: No deadline listed.
cases.score_3: Says none listed but guesses (e.g. 'probably rolling').
cases.score_1: Invents a date.
